title: In 2025, Solar Still Pays Off - Especially with the Right Partner
summary: With 6nergies and SunPower, enjoy reliable solar energy across the Rhône‑Alpes region and cut your long‑term energy costs.
body_markdown:
##### Fewer subsidies? More sunshine.


In 2025, many homeowners are asking the same question: *Is solar still worth it?* ‍


The answer is clear: **absolutely - and more than ever.**


But to fully unlock the benefits of solar, choosing the right partner matters just as much as choosing the right technology.


## Profitability is about more than numbers


For us, solar isn’t just about short‑term savings on your electricity bill.
True profitability also means:


✨ The peace of mind that comes from a reliable system
🔧 The quality of a thoughtfully designed installation
🌱 And a long‑lasting solution that keeps delivering value for decades


This is exactly where our partner[6nergies](https://6nergies.fr/) makes the difference.


## Why work with a SunPower Elite Partner like 6nergies?


The **Elite Partner** label represents the highest level of recognition at SunPower.
It is awarded to installers who:


- have full mastery of our solar technologies, among the most efficient in the world
- guide customers from start to finish with clear, personalized advice
- deliver precise, fast installations that meet the highest industry standards


Thanks to their deep knowledge of local conditions like rooftops, climate, and energy‑use habits, 6nergies designs systems that are genuinely made to measure.


6nergies supports homeowners and small commercial clients throughout[l’Ain, le Rhône, l’Isère, la Loire et la Haute-Loire](https://6nergies.fr/nos-installations/) .


👉 In short: **premium solar, without the headaches.**


## Real projects. Real‑world results.


🔹 In **Saint‑Jean‑de‑Bournay** , Mr. Jonrond made an early move. He installed SunPower Maxeon panels **back in 2018** , paired with intelligent hot‑water management system. Today, the system has already paid for itself, generating **€19,000 in cumulative savings** . And it doesn’t stop there - projections reach nearly €90,000 by 2043. A forward‑thinking decision that continues to deliver year after year.


🔹 In **Morancé** , Mr. Mercier opted for a compact system: **8 Performance 6 AC Black panels** installed on his home. Small setup? Perhaps. Yet it generates enough energy to cover more than half of his household consumption. The result: **€836 saved in the first year alone** , and over €28,000 in savings over 25 years. Proof that a modest installation can still have a major impact. As with the other projects shared by 6nergies, this one clearly shows that bigger isn’t always better.


🔹 In **Ruy‑Montceau** , Mr. Gambier chose a more powerful configuration: **22 SunPower Performance 6 AC Black panels** , for a total capacity of 9 kWp. His system now covers close to **60% of his energy needs** . Over 20 years, projected savings exceed €83,500, with full payback in under six years. A strong step toward true energy independence.


🔹 In **Dolomieu** , Mr. Barbier selected a well‑balanced solution with **12 SunPower Performance 6 DC panels** . Annual production reaches around 6,000 kWh, covering nearly half of his consumption. **Savings exceed €1,100 per year** - a simple, efficient system built for long‑term performance.


## Technology that delivers, day after day


SunPower Maxeon and Performance panels are more than just high‑output modules.
They’re engineered for longevity, with Maxeon panels offering **over 40 years of guaranteed performance** , even in demanding conditions.


High efficiency, exceptional resistance to corrosion, and some of the strongest warranties on the market make these panels a smart long‑term asset as well as an environmentally responsible choice.


💡 **The result?** Stable, reliable energy generation that’s easy to monitor and manage.
Elite Partners like 6nergies know this technology inside out, ensuring your solar system is as **intelligent as it is durable.**


## Solar still makes financial sense - especially when it’s done right


Even with reduced incentives, a properly designed and well‑oriented solar installation delivers:


- immediate **reductions in energy bills**
- a return on investment in as little as **6 to 12 years**
- and long‑term peace of mind, with **over 25 years of guaranteed production** — or up to 40 years with Maxeon panels


## In short


🌞 Solar remains a smart and profitable choice
🤝 With 6nergies, your project is in expert hands
